items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report 2026 states wealth management is shifting from product-centric distribution to empathy-led advice that extends beyond portfolios into the broader context of clients' lives, a shift accelerated by AI enabling augmented intelligence that enhances rather than replaces human judgment.
items.quote: wealth management is shifting from product-centric distribution to empathy-led advice - advice that extends beyond portfolios into the broader context of clients' lives.

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report 2026 states advisory roles and incentive structures are being redefined so relationship managers use augmented intelligence to orchestrate experiences across the full wealth ecosystem, with a roadmap shifting toward AI-augmented advisory orchestration, autonomous tailored portfolio delivery, proactive insight-led advice, and trusted human-AI collaboration.
items.quote: Advisory roles and incentive structures are redefined to ensure that RMs leverage augmented intelligence to orchestrate experiences across the full wealth ecosystem... Shift towards AI-augmentation advisory orchestration... Move towards autonomous, tailored portfolio delivery... Enable proactive, insight-led advice... Establish trusted human-AI collaboration

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report 2026 states engagement models will evolve so that life transitions, liquidity events, and behavioral signals determine when and how firms interact with clients, replacing calendar-driven review cycles with relevance-driven ones.
items.quote: Engagement models will evolve in parallel: life transitions, liquidity events, and behavioral signals will increasingly determine when and how firms interact with clients, replacing calendar-driven review cycles with relevance-driven ones.

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report 2026 distinguishes automation (removing tasks from human workflows) from augmentation (strengthening human capability with better information, faster insights, and broader context to enable better decisions and client engagement).
items.quote: Automation removes tasks from human workflows and performs them using technology. Augmentation strengthens human capability by providing better information, faster insights, and broader context, enabling better decisions and more meaningful client engagement.

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report 2026 states firms should redirect relationship-manager focus so AI handles data analysis and pattern recognition while RMs focus on life planning, deeper advisory work, and judgment calls requiring human empathy, and should align incentive models to reward holistic advice and client outcomes.
items.quote: Redirect focus: AI handles data analysis and pattern recognition collected during client conversations so that RMs can focus on life planning, deeper advisory work, and judgment calls that require human empathy and contextual understanding.

items.text: McKinsey states AI will aggressively assume specific tasks (preparation, data extraction, document drafting), that nearly 80 percent of affluent households still prefer a human relationship, but that an AI takeover might be possible for standardized, lower-touch service models and younger clients.
items.quote: nearly 80 percent of affluent households still prefer a human relationship, though an AI takeover might indeed be possible for standardized, lower-touch service models and for younger clients, who are increasingly comfortable with AI-only interfaces.

items.text: McKinsey states AI will quickly replace tasks such as preparation, extraction, drafting, and scenario planning, but replacing tasks is not the same as replacing the advisor's role as the human accountable for judgment, trust, and behavioral coaching.
items.quote: AI will quickly replace tasks such as preparation, extraction, drafting, and scenario planning, especially in document-heavy planning and service work. Replacing tasks is not the same as replacing the advisor's role as the human accountable for judgment, trust, and behavioral coaching.

items.text: McKinsey states the winners in wealth management are being defined as those that can integrate AI into the operating system of advice, securely and compliantly, in a way that keeps the human relationship at the front end of trust.
items.quote: The winners in wealth management are already being defined not as those that create the flashiest planning demo but as those that can integrate AI into the operating system of advice, securely and compliantly, in a way that keeps the human relationship at the front end of trust.

items.text: Deloitte states the advice model may shift away from individual effort toward apprenticeship, specialization, and technology leverage, driving more teaming and practice consolidation, and that agentic AI can help firms extend high-touch planning to a broader client base and serve less complex clients more economically.
items.quote: Over time, the model may shift away from individual effort toward apprenticeship, specialization, and technology leverage—driving more teaming, greater practice consolidation... Agentic AI can help firms extend high-touch planning to a broader client base.

items.text: Cerulli states that for the past decade financial firms have shifted their compensation models from largely commission-based to an asset-related fee structure, and that fee-based planning is the most preferred form of compensating an advisor among affluent investors.
items.quote: For the past decade, financial firms have shifted their compensation models from largely commission-based to an asset-related fee structure.

items.text: Schwab's CEO states more of its retail clients are seeking holistic financial advice delivered seamlessly on their terms through a combination of people and increasingly AI-enabled technology.
items.quote: more of our retail clients are seeking holistic financial advice delivered seamlessly on their terms through a combination of people and increasingly AI-enabled technology.

items.text: Schwab's investor-day deck identifies growing demand for holistic advice, desire for ease across wealth, banking, and investing, and rising investor expectations for sophisticated, personalized solutions as key trends.
items.quote: Growing demand for holistic advice... Desire for ease across wealth, banking, & investing... Rising investor expectations for sophisticated, personalized solutions

items.text: Bank of America's CEO states AI is helping wealth management relationship managers and advisors search and summarize information, preparing them to deliver personalized planning and personalized pitches to clients.
items.quote: In wealth management and our other relationship manager banking businesses, AI is helping those relationship managers and advisors search and summarize information, preparing them to deliver personalized planning and personalized pitches to clients.

items.text: Raymond James' CEO states the firm wants to use AI to empower its financial professionals to better serve clients, in contrast to competitors that plan to use AI to go around their advisors and directly to clients.
items.quote: we're really wanting to use AI to help our financial professionals and our financial advisors better serve their clients, where many of our competitors have used technology and are planning on using AI to essentially try to get around their financial advisors to go direct to their clients.

items.text: Raymond James describes its Private Wealth Guided Portfolios as built to sit behind the advisor rather than displace them, preserving the advisor's role as the primary point of contact for each client.
items.quote: Rather than displacing the advisor, the framework is built to sit behind them, providing research and consultation support while preserving the advisor's role as the primary point of contact for each client.

items.text: A Schwab survey found only 7% of advisors said they use agentic AI, and Nevis founder Swan predicts advisors will have hundreds of AI agents supporting them with services such as building wealth and estate plans, filing taxes, opening custody accounts, and moving money.
items.quote: only 7% of advisors said they use agentic AI... I think advisors will have literally hundreds of agents supporting them with a broad range of services to clients. You will have agents that build wealth and estate plans, agents that will file taxes on behalf of clients. You will have agents that are opening custody accounts and moving money.
items.unit: percent of advisors using agentic AI
items.definition: systems that make decisions and take actions independently within workflows

items.text: Trade press reports a broad independence movement, with an advisor stating that moving to independence gives the flexibility to tailor the approach around each family's unique needs and goals.
items.quote: Moving to independence gives us the flexibility to tailor our approach around each family's unique needs and goals.
